title: Experience & Progress: 过, 正在, 一直, 刚 / 刚才, 从来
description: Have you ever (过), in the middle of (正在…呢), all along (一直), just (刚 vs 刚才) and never (从来不 / 从来没).

points.title: Verb + 过: have (ever) done
points.summary: 过 (guo) marks an experience — something you've done at least once. Negative: 没 + verb + 过.
points.body:
- 我吃**过**饺子 (I've had dumplings before).
- 我没去**过**上海 (I've never been to Shanghai).
- 了 = a specific finished event; 过 = 'ever'.

points.title: (正)在 + verb (+ 呢): in progress
points.summary: 正在 / 在 + verb = be doing right now. 呢 at the end is common.
points.body:
- 我**正在**做饭**呢**.
- 他们**在**开会.

points.title: 一直: all along, continuously
points.summary: 一直 (yìzhí) + verb = has been / kept doing all along.
points.body:
- 雨**一直**下了三天.
- 我**一直**想去中国.
examples: I've always wanted to go to China.

points.title: 刚 vs 刚才: just / just now
points.summary: 刚 (gāng) is an adverb: subject + 刚 + verb, can take a duration (刚来了一个月). 刚才 (gāngcái) is a time noun = a moment ago; it can start the sentence and go with 没/不.
points.body:
- 我**刚**到家.
- **刚才**你去哪儿了?
- 他**刚**来了一个月 — not ~~刚才来了一个月~~.
examples: Where did you go just now?

points.title: 从来 + 不 / 没(有): never
points.summary: 从来不 = never (habit / principle). 从来没(有) + verb + 过 = have never (experience).
points.body:
- 他**从来不**喝酒.
- 我**从来没**吃**过**北京烤鸭.

notes: 过 goes right after the verb.
Experience is negated with 没, not 不.

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{在|zài}{做|zuò}{什么|shénme}？
B：{我|wǒ}（　）{做饭|zuòfàn}{呢|ne}。
notes: 已经做饭呢 doesn't fit — 已经 needs 了.
questions.translation: A: What are you doing? B: I'm cooking.

notes: 正在 and 过 don't go together.
questions.translation: Don't go in — they're in a meeting.

notes: 刚 + three days of rain doesn't fit 还没停.
正在 doesn't combine with 了 + duration.
questions.translation: It's been raining for three days without stopping.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}（　）{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōngguó}{留学|liúxué}，{明年|míngnián}{终于|zhōngyú}{可以|kěyǐ}{去|qù}{了|le}。
questions.translation: I've always wanted to study in China — next year I finally can.

notes: 一直 can't start the sentence like this.
刚 is an adverb — it can't start the sentence.
已经 can't start the sentence like this.
questions.translation: Where did you go just now? I've been looking for you for ages.

notes: 刚才 can't go with a duration like 一个月.
questions.translation: He came only a month ago and isn't used to it yet.

notes: 已经不 would need 了 at the end.
